Definition: from G2413 and the same as G4241; reverent:--as becometh holiness.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hieroprepḗs means reverent, as becometh holiness. It occurs just once, in Titus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hieroprepḗs needs no more than its plain sense — reverent, as becometh holiness.
